title: Fluid power systems and components - connectors and associated components - Nominal pressures
clause_1_scope: This Indian Standard prescribes nominal pressures for hydraulic and pneumatic fluid power connectors and associated components.

clause_2_normative_references.title: Specification for Reday Mixed Paint, Brushing, Zinc Chrome, Priming (Third Revision)

marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
